_regime: A public blog: no accounts, no forms, no database. The general regime is enough — nothing here is data whose confidentiality answers to a particular framework.
_signing: The key expected for this repository's reports, and for the endorsement of this declaration. Its public halves live here, so changing it is a commit somebody reads; its private halves live in ~/.sablier and never enter the repository. A signature that verifies against whatever key travelled with it proves only that a key exists. Replaced on 2026-10-16: the private halves of the previous pair (+B/8vbI5…) were lost, not leaked as far as we know; reports signed before that date still verify against the old public key, kept in this file's history.
_lifetimes: This repository is the case the tool has to handle without dramatising anything: almost everything in it is meant to be read by anybody. Declaring zero is an answer, and it is the one that stops published content being treated as a problem.

contenu publié.note: Articles, gabarits et générateur. Tout est écrit pour être servi en clair à qui le demande : la confidentialité due est nulle, par construction et pas par négligence.

chaîne de déploiement.note: Scripts de provisionnement et de publication. Ils décrivent la configuration du serveur, y compris son TLS, et ne contiennent aucun secret : la clé SSH qui les exécute vit sur le poste de travail et n'entre jamais dans le dépôt. Si ces fichiers sortaient, ils n'apprendraient rien à personne — c'est aussi pour ça qu'ils sont lisibles.

_probe: This site's real cryptography is not in its files: it is negotiated by the server. Without this line the report would see nothing and say so — with it, it goes and looks.
_service_until: Not declared: this blog has no planned end date. The report flags that as the optimistic assumption, which is exactly what it is.
